strings.title: Privacy Policy
strings.hero: The Doughnut Forge app is built on a zero-knowledge, local-first architecture. The app collects nothing: it does not collect, transmit or store any of your data, and the developer has no access to it, except information you choose to send directly (see Section 3). This website is covered separately, in Section 6.
strings.sec1Desc: All cryptographic keys, .vltc2 identities, and .vlt2 files generated by Doughnut Forge are stored exclusively on your local device. No information leaves your device unless you explicitly export and share a file yourself. Uninstalling the app removes the software, but it does not remove files you have saved elsewhere on your device, or keys held in your system's credential manager (such as the macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager). You can delete these manually.
strings.sec2Title: 2. Analytics and Telemetry in the App
strings.sec2Desc: The Doughnut Forge app contains no built-in tracking scripts, analytics engines, or crash reporters. If you download the app from the Apple App Store or Microsoft Store, Apple or Microsoft may provide us with aggregated statistics such as download counts and crash statistics. These reports do not contain personally identifiable information. You can control the sharing of diagnostic data in your device settings.
strings.sec3Desc: For questions or to report a technical issue, please open a ticket on our [[gh]]GitHub Issues[[/gh]] tracker. GitHub is a public platform governed by its own privacy policy, so never include sensitive or decrypted data in issue reports. For privacy-specific enquiries, please use our [[tally]]Privacy Contact Form[[/tally]]. Information you submit through that form is processed by Tally (tally.so), which we use to receive your message, and is used only to respond to your enquiry.
strings.sec4Desc: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page with an updated Effective Date.
strings.sec5Desc: For enquiries submitted via our contact form, we process your information on the basis of our legitimate interest in providing support. We keep messages only for as long as reasonably necessary to deal with your enquiry, and we aim to delete them periodically afterwards. If you would like your messages deleted sooner, just ask using the same form. Depending on where you live (for example, under UK data protection law), you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your communications with us, and to lodge a complaint with the UK [[ico]]Information Commissioner's Office (ICO)[[/ico]]. Doughnut Forge is not directed at children under 13. If you believe a child has sent us personal information through our contact form, please let us know and we will delete it.
strings.sec6Counts: This website counts page views anonymously, to understand which pages help people. It keeps daily totals only: the pages viewed, the language of each page, the country (as a two-letter code, never a city), the referring site (its domain only) and taps on store buttons. Each is a separate total, and they are never stored together.
strings.sec6Never: It never keeps IP addresses, browser identity strings, full addresses, times, or anything that links one visit to another. It sets no cookies.
strings.sec6Device: The counter stores nothing on your device. The only things this website stores there are an opt-out flag in your browser's local storage, if you choose not to be counted, and one build number in your browser's session storage, so an open tab can tell when the site has been updated.
strings.sec6Processor: The counter runs on Cloudflare (Workers and D1, with the database stored in Western Europe). Cloudflare's network sees your IP address to deliver the request and to look up the country; the counter never reads or stores it. Cloudflare also adds its own network error reporting to its responses. See [[cf]]Cloudflare's Privacy Policy[[/cf]].
strings.sec6Basis: The legal basis for these counts is legitimate interest, in understanding which pages help people. Daily totals are deleted after 13 months.
strings.sec6OptOut: To stop being counted, use the “Do not count my visits” button on [[stats]]Page views on this site[[/stats]], turn on Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, or turn off JavaScript. Content blockers may also stop the count.
strings.sec6Public: The totals are public on [[stats]]Page views on this site[[/stats]], and the counter's source code is public under analytics-worker/ in [[repo]]this website's repository[[/repo]].
strings.sec6Hosting: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may log technical information, such as your IP address, when you visit, for security and to operate the service; see [[ghp]]GitHub's Privacy Statement[[/ghp]].
